originalAlarm.description: Memory dynamically allocated by `malloc` on line 10 is not freed after the last access at line 11, column 7.

model:
(define-fun SSL_CTX_set_ecdh_auto () Bool
  true)
(define-fun HAVE_ECC () Bool
  true)
reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE (OVER-CONSTRAINED): Same file as PRODUCT_97/98 etc. (35ae2e259e4.c, Apache SSL). MEMORY_LEAK_C: eckey is allocated with malloc at line 10 (inside #ifdef HAVE_ECC) and never freed before the function returns. This is the known vbdb MemoryLeak bug. OVER-CONSTRAINED: The memory leak exists whenever HAVE_ECC=true, regardless of SSL_CTX_set_ecdh_auto. When SSL_CTX_set_ecdh_auto=true, the else branch at line 14-18 compiles as empty code (comment only), but eckey is still allocated at line 10 and not freed. When SSL_CTX_set_ecdh_auto=false, eckey is still allocated and not freed. The presence condition's requirement for SSL_CTX_set_ecdh_auto=true is unnecessary.
